question: 单项选择：I _____ a book at 8 last night. A. read  B. was reading  C. am reading  D. will read
answer: 答案：B. was reading。解析：at 8 last night是过去某时，"正在做"用过去进行时。强调动作进行。

question: 单项选择：I _____ a book yesterday. A. read  B. was reading  C. am reading  D. will read
answer: 答案：A. read。解析：yesterday是一般过去时，强调动作完成。read的过去式仍是read（发音/red/）。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：At 9 last night, I ______ (watch) TV.
answer: 答案：was watching。解析：at 9 last night是过去某时，用过去进行时强调进行。完整：At 9 last night, I was watching TV.

question: 单项选择：I _____ my keys yesterday. I still can't find them. A. lose  B. lost  C. was losing  D. am losing
answer: 答案：B. lost。解析：yesterday是一般过去时，强调动作完成。I still can't find them说明动作已完成（结果）。

question: 翻译句子：昨天晚上八点我在看电视。
answer: 答案：I was watching TV at 8 last night. 解析：at 8 last night是过去某时，用过去进行时强调正在进行。

question: 单项选择：I _____ my keys all morning yesterday. A. lose  B. lost  C. was losing  D. am losing
answer: 答案：C. was losing。解析：all morning yesterday是过去一段时间，用过去进行时强调持续进行。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (read) the book yesterday. I've finished it.
answer: 答案：read。解析：yesterday是一般过去时，强调动作完成。I've finished说明结果。

question: 单项选择：I _____ when the phone rang. A. cook  B. cooked  C. was cooking  D. am cooking
answer: 答案：C. was cooking。解析：when the phone rang是一般过去时，主句用过去进行时强调正在做。

question: 翻译句子：昨天下午我在图书馆读书。
answer: 答案：I was reading in the library yesterday afternoon. 解析：yesterday afternoon是过去某时，可以用过去进行时强调进行。

question: 单项选择：I _____ to the cinema last night. I had a great time. A. go  B. went  C. was going  D. am going
answer: 答案：B. went。解析：last night是一般过去时，强调动作完成。I had a great time是过去完成时呼应。
